title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1305 U.S. Highway 90 West in Castroville, Texas, as the Lance Corporal Rhonald Dain Rairdan Post Office.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1305 U.S. Highway 90 West in Castroville, Texas, as the "Lance Corporal Rhonald Dain Rairdan Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a post office in Castroville, Texas, after Lance Corporal Rhonald Dain Rairdan.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1305 U.S. Highway 90 West in Castroville, Texas, as the Lance Corporal Rhonald Dain Rairdan Post Office. It changes only the name of the building. It does not change how mail is handled or who works there.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the new name applies from that date.
